prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot hand-painted illustrated 2D side-scrolling game sprite art. Muted blue-gray stone, moss green, warm wood/soil and restrained amber/cyan magical accents. Crisp readable full silhouettes and soft painterly local material shading; not pixel art, photoreal or 3D. ONE SQUARE transparent PNG atlas in EXACTLY TWO EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS, four equal square cells. Each cell contains one complete named object/state with generous transparent margin at least12% on every side. Fixed side-on orthographic game camera, no floor, perspective groundplane, scenery, characters, UI, arrows, labels, text, gridlines, shadows, border, glow cloud or vignette. Genuine alpha-zero outside solid objects and tightly bounded requested local light. Don't let artwork cross a cell boundary. Consistent scale, alignment, base level, object geometry and pivot between states. Level exit doorway/portal: one complete root-trimmed blue-gray stone arch and low sill, generic design compatible with ancient woodland temples. Four identical aligned arch state proposals: upper-left dormant dark arch with transparent opening; upper-right faint thin cyan light only along inner arch; lower-left active subtle amber/cyan portal membrane confined entirely INSIDE the arch opening; lower-right empty open arch with a few tiny restrained amber edge accents and transparent opening. Keep arch outer silhouette, geometry, moss, scale and ground pivot identical across four cells. No vista/landscape through doorway, text/signs, giant light beams, square background or terrain. Active membrane bounded by arch, all outer canvas truly transparent. Four static art states only.
